Class Ui

java.lang.Object
io.mcs.taskmanager.ui.kit.Ui
public final class Ui extends Object
The pieces the window is built of, styled by taskmanager.css: text, buttons, key caps, fields' labels, and the alert and notice a refusal is shown in. Black is kept for the one main action of a place; every other button is white with a hairline.
Author:
Hamza Rasool, Abdullah Khan

    • uncached

      public static <C extends javafx.scene.control.Control> C uncached(C control)
      Draws a control's scrolling content straight to the window. JavaFX renders a scroll pane's viewport through a cached bitmap, which at display scales such as 125% cuts the tops off its text; a text area scrolls through one too. Every scroll pane and text area in the app goes through this.
      Type Parameters:
      C - the control's type
      Parameters:
      control - the scroll pane or text area
      Returns:
      the same control
